scope: Explorer A asynchronous filesystem operations and bounded UTF-8 text preview; production view/navigation/dialog routing still pending

linux.environment: WSL Alpine-Dev GCC15.2, SDL3.2.30, ASan/UBSan detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1

counterexample.change: Only request-version comparison removed from result publication in isolated fixture; worktree product source unchanged
counterexample.expected_actual_failure: The completed old A listing is published while a newer B request is pending; result version assertion rejects it

earlier_cohort.finding: Windows passed2/2. Linux model passed, worker fixture could not create a named FIFO on D DrvFS. Separate actual probe confirms errno95 Not supported.
earlier_cohort.correction: Use an actual anonymous pipe descriptor through /proc/self/fd; no temporary fixture files outside D. Also remove an intentional signed-char constant-cast compiler warning.

verified_behaviors: One active SDL thread plus latest pending request; request/result ownership survives caller buffer overwrite.
Semaphore-gated actual stale completion is rejected; intermediate request coalesced; negative compiled version guard fixture fails.
Mid-text-read cancellation, re-request while cancelled work unwinds, published list ownership, shutdown join and fresh worker reopen.
Empty text, optional UTF8 BOM, exact65536-byte boundary, six internal cut positions of2/3/4-byte codepoints, malformed/surrogate/out-of-range/control rejection and lookahead validation.
Stale deleted file confirmation; invalid request leaves previous pending request intact; exclusive mkdir, collision and cancellation after real mutation without false rollback promise.
Real regular-file preview beyond Windows MAX_PATH, actual POSIX link/dotdot target, special-file rejection through an anonymous pipe with no writer.
limitations: Production APP list still lacks browser modules; existing system dialogs remain. Navigation/history/selection, native A view and all caller routing still need integration.
Only bounded regular UTF8 text preview implemented; run/image previews and C API context remain outstanding. No fake scene or demonstration data substituted.
Worker tests enable only additional semaphore gates via PS_BROWSER_WORKER_TESTING; no general race-freedom or ThreadSanitizer proof. No macOS runtime proof.
Cancel cannot interrupt an already active kernel/filesystem call, and destruction joins that call. A completed exclusive mkdir is not undone by cancellation.
Opened-handle size can differ from contents under external concurrent writing; preview is not an atomic file snapshot.
An anonymous pipe is proven on Linux; named FIFO unsupported on required D fixture filesystem and not claimed. Existing SMB/ACL/allocation-injection/locale-sort gaps remain.
No UI, screenreader, theme, DPI, native long-path open/import end-to-end or complete design acceptance follows from these units.
Manual Windows physical arrow/focus proof remains deferred at user request. No manual test window launched.
All new persistent data on D; F not accessed; frozen artifacts and unrelated working-tree edits retained.
